event_score.information_ratio_note: IR = IC * sqrt(BR) requires BR to be the number of genuinely independent bets per year. The project's measured 1.15 is the effective number of independent STRATEGIES, which is a different quantity. Multiplying a cross-sectional IC by a cross-strategy breadth conflates two things and would produce a meaningless number, so no IR is published here.
